description: Test MCP Servers written in Type for Jotsu workflows.   Each server is hosted and publicly available for workflow use (see Hosted Endpoints).

readme.content:
# mcp-servers-ts

This repository is a TypeScript monorepo containing a collection of test MCP servers.  
These servers are used to power various Jotsu workflow examples and are adapted from Cloudflare reference implementations.

## 🌐 Hosted Endpoints

Live deployments are available at:

- https://test.mcp.jotsu.com
- https://test-oauth.mcp.jotsu.com
